source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved Serial Port Console Redirection values persist across save/reboot and return to SPEC defaults after Load Default while console output/input remain mapped to the intended endpoint and recovery access is preserved.
original_method: Change redirection fields in BIOS, save/reboot and verify persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot and compare with SPEC, collecting BIOS, serial/console, boot and log evidence.
manual_activity: A human must navigate the BIOS redirection page, change fields, execute both save/reboot phases, select Load Default and verify firmware values and intended console behavior. Serial capture automation does not replace these core actions.
required_inputs: Physical COM or BMC SOL endpoint mapping and ownership
Named fields with baseline, non-default and SPEC-default values
Complete terminal framing/emulation and input policy
Console/operator, terminal capture, stable power and alternate OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or guess COM/SOL mapping or terminal parameters.
Confirm the test endpoint belongs to this SUT before sending keyboard input.
Maintain an independent recovery path before changing the only console route.
Avoid transmitting secrets through captured boot/console streams.
Stop on wrong target, unreadable output, missing boot console or management loss.
Restore the approved final mapping and do not retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only serial/COM/SOL inventory, timestamped console output and BMC/OS health where approved.
Compare captured output and operator BIOS evidence against the endpoint/field matrix.
Do not drive BIOS, send unapproved console input, expose secrets or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Define/approve endpoint ownership, field/default matrix, input scope and recovery.
Perform/capture persistence and default-restoration phases and any approved keyboard check.
Evaluate firmware and console behavior and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects BIOS automation. No source command exists; a terminal/SOL capture can support evidence but must use the approved endpoint and parameters and cannot substitute the firmware page.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain manual BIOS control and use an approved timestamped serial/SOL capture tool for the mapped endpoint; do not use OS console redirection as a replacement.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source two-phase sequence, no-script state and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; all/random remains source wording but is not an executable selection method.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a matrix of BIOS field, COM/SOL endpoint, terminal framing/emulation, non-default and SPEC-default values; capture synchronized BIOS transitions and boot-console transcripts for both reboot phases, with input testing only when explicitly approved.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS, UART routing, BMC SOL implementation and terminal endpoint.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, terminal client/capture and serial adapter firmware versions where applicable.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform Serial Port Console Redirection and BMC SOL mapping documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds endpoint identity, complete framing and objective console transcripts while retaining firmware persistence/default coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; input-path coverage is explicit rather than assumed from readable output.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Endpoint ownership/map, terminal settings, input policy and alternate recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Readable output does not prove keyboard routing, and SOL may not represent a physical UART; evidence must identify the tested path.

project_override_considerations: The project selects physical UART, SOL or both and defines permitted input. Results apply only to named endpoints; a successful SOL path must not be reported as physical COM coverage or vice versa.
expected_evidence: Identity, endpoint/ownership map, approval and alternate recovery
First save/reboot persistence captures and timestamped output/input evidence
Load Default, second save/reboot, SPEC comparison and console recovery
Final mapping, boot/BMC health, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require persistence and SPEC-default restoration. Missing endpoint and terminal specifics are project readiness inputs, not conflicting source facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The serial-redirection purpose is clear. Endpoint/field details and alternate recovery gate execution but do not permanently block the library case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with manual BIOS classification and adds serial-path identity and recovery-specific evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains COM/terminal ownership, output/input and alternate-recovery controls while applying V3.1 readiness semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates endpoint-specific coverage, capture automation and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents input from reaching the wrong host and prevents loss of the only management channel while producing path-specific console evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Human firmware navigation and visual setting confirmation are central, so MANUAL ONLY applies even though serial transcripts can be captured automatically. The result must remain endpoint-specific.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat redirection changes, console input, reboot or default load after a mapping/output/management anomaly; preserve transcripts and obtain engineer disposition.
